fdroid:de.monocles.chat.name: monocles chat
fdroid:de.monocles.chat.summary: is a full-featured XMPP chat client
fdroid:de.monocles.chat.description:
monocles chat is a modern and secure XMPP chat client for Android. It is based on Conversations, includes features from blabber.im and Cheogram, and adds many changes and features of its own to improve usability and security.
Connection security and the protection of personal data are very important to us. We enforce encrypted connections between the app and the server, which makes it almost impossible for strangers to intercept and read your messages. For this reason we removed outdated cipher suites. The remaining ones are tuned for the monocles chat server, but stay compatible with other XMPP servers that follow today’s standards.
If that is not enough for you, you can use end-to-end message encryption such as OMEMO or OpenPGP. Messages are then encrypted on the sending device and can only be decrypted by the devices they are meant for.
Features:
* End-to-end encryption with OTR , OMEMO or OpenPGP 
* Experimental post-quantum end-to-end encryption (PQ OMEMO2)
* Encrypted connections only, TLS 1.3 required by default
* DNSSEC-verified server lookup and DANE certificate checks (can be enforced)
* Protection against login downgrade attacks (channel binding, SCRAM downgrade protection)
* Encrypted local database with an optional startup password
* Send and receive images and other files
* Send and receive locations
* Send and receive voice messages
* Message styling: bold, italic, strikethrough and code
* Profile pictures (avatars) of your contacts
* Synchronize message history with other clients
* Group chats and channels
* Address book integration (your address book is never shared with the server)
* Audio and video calls
* Very low battery consumption
* Status messages
* Daily backup of the database to local storage
Need help? Join our support group chat support@conference.monocles.eu .

fdroid:edge.roll.description:
Edge Roll is a minimalist one-thumb arcade game. Swipe to tumble a cube end over end along a narrow bridge of floating tiles suspended over an abyss.
Every tile you step off begins to crumble and drops away a second or two later — and that grace period shrinks the higher you climb, so hesitation is fatal. The bridge wanders left and right, splits into branches, and is dotted with gem spurs worth bonus points and gaps that end the run if you roll into them.
Score one point for every new tile you reach; gems are worth three. The whole world drifts through the colour spectrum as you progress, and a single misjudged roll sends the cube spinning off into the dark.
Features:
* One-thumb controls: swipe to roll, tap to roll forward.
* A procedurally generated bridge — no two runs are alike.
* Tight, tactile feedback with synchronised sound and haptics.
* A local high score. No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no network access.
* Tiny download and fully playable offline.
Edge Roll is built with libGDX and is free and open-source software, licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

fdroid:io.github.omegadestroyer.pairfree.name: PairFree
fdroid:io.github.omegadestroyer.pairfree.summary: One light app for earbuds of many brands. No account, no internet, no tracking
fdroid:io.github.omegadestroyer.pairfree.description:
PairFree aims to be one app for the settings of nearly any earbuds and headphones. It replaces heavy, brand-specific apps with a light, fast one that talks to your earbuds directly over Bluetooth.
Why PairFree:
• No account: nothing to sign up for or log in to
• No internet: the app has no internet permission, so it cannot go online
• Nothing leaves your phone unless you share it yourself, such as a device report or an equalizer profile. No ads, no analytics, no crash reports, no cloud backup of your settings
• One app to rule them all: the same screens for every brand, instead of one vendor app each
• Few permissions: Bluetooth, for earbuds you have already paired, and notifications for the optional status notification. For JBL and QCY models alone, finding nearby devices, asked for only when you open one and never used for your location. No location, no contacts
• Small and quick: about 3 MB, with no login and no server to wait for
• Open source (GPL-3.0), with every protocol documented and tested in its repository
• Your equalizer as files: save your own curves, and export and share them
• Translations: the app has a language picker, and a new language is one file added by pull request
Supported brands:
• SOUNDPEATS: 88 models, tried on the H3, Air5 Pro+, C30, T3 Pro and TRUEFREE Clip C10
• Soundcore (Anker): 67 models, tried on the Space A40, AeroClip, Q20i and Sleep A20. With the open-source OpenSCQ30
• Samsung Galaxy Buds: 16 models, from the 2019 Buds to the Buds4 Pro. From Samsung's plugin and the open-source GalaxyBudsClient
• Sony: 24 models, from the WH-1000XM2 to the WH-1000XM6, tried on the WF-1000XM5. From Sony's app, checked against Gadgetbridge
• Bose: 22 models, from the QC35 to the QC Ultra 2. From Bose's app and bosectl, without Bose's cloud
• AirPods and Beats on Apple's chips: 30 models, tried on the AirPods Pro 3, from LibrePods and Apple's Beats app. AirPods need Android 17, or a Pixel on 16 QPR3, or a OnePlus, OPPO or realme phone on 16; the Beats need no particular version
• JBL: 112 models, tried on the Live Buds 3. From JBL's app, checked against JblTray
• Nothing and CMF: 19 models. From Nothing X, checked against nada and nadamas
• Google Pixel Buds: 5 models, tried on the Pro. From Google's app, checked against pbpctrl
• QCY: 194 models, tried on the H3 Pro and T13 ANC2. From QCY's app, checked against OpenQCY-Desktop
• 1MORE: 39 models. From 1MORE's app
• EarFun: 26 models. From EarFun's app, checked against Gadgetbridge
• Cambridge Audio: 8 models, Melomania 1+ and Touch and the Melomania Connect earbuds. From the Melomania apps
• OnePlus and OPPO: 53 models, tried on the Buds 4. From HeyMelody
What it controls, on the models that have each:
• Battery for each earbud and the case
• Noise control: off, noise cancelling, transparency or ambient sound, with their scenes and levels
• The equalizer: the brand's presets, your own curves and saved profiles
• Touch controls: what each tap and hold does on each earbud, and turning touch off
• Game mode, two devices at once, LDAC and LE Audio
• The ear tip fit test on SOUNDPEATS, Galaxy Buds, Nothing and CMF, Pixel Buds, Soundcore's A3951 family, OnePlus and OPPO, and a seal check with tones from the phone for every other brand; find my earbuds, voice prompts and water drain

The goal of the Relagent project is an accessible solution for agentic AI services with full control over your data. What Relagent brings you:
* 🗨️ Chat interface : Chat with your AI assistant and manage sessions.

flathub:cc.craftos_pc.CraftOS-PC.name: CraftOS-PC
flathub:cc.craftos_pc.CraftOS-PC.description:
CraftOS-PC is a fantasy terminal that allows you to write and run 
 programs inside an '80s-style text console.
 CraftOS-PC emulates the popular Minecraft mod "ComputerCraft", which 
 adds programmable computers to Minecraft using the Lua programming 
 language. CraftOS-PC takes this experience outside Minecraft to allow 
 you to run the same programs anywhere you go.
 CraftOS-PC provides a set of functions (called APIs) that make it super 
 easy to do simple tasks such as write text to the screen, read files, 
 and more. The simplicity of these functions makes CraftOS-PC great for 
 new programmers, but their power makes it possible to write all sorts of
 complex programs with less code.
 If you aren't ready to write programs yet, there's already a large 
 number of programs for ComputerCraft that will work in CraftOS-PC, 
 ranging from simple games to whole graphical operating systems. These 
 can be downloaded through the built-in Pastebin and GitHub Gist clients.

flathub:io.github.dosbox-staging.description:
DOSBox Staging is a modern continuation of DOSBox with advanced features and current development

flathub:io.github.huderlem.porymap.name: Porymap
flathub:io.github.huderlem.porymap.summary: A map editor for the Pokémon generation 3 decompilation projects
flathub:io.github.huderlem.porymap.description:
Porymap is a cross-platform map editor for the Gen 3 pret decompilation projects. Its primary functions are to allow editing map tiles, collision, events, connections, and properties. Porymap provides additional functionality, such as tileset editing and region map editing.
 Those familiar with traditional Gen 3 binary ROM hacking can think of it as the Advance Map equivalent for the decompilation projects. Porymap supports the same features as Advance Map, so Advance Map users shouldn’t have much difficulty learning how to use Porymap. There are many usability improvements in Porymap. The most notable is undo/redo when painting map tiles.
 Porymap reads and writes files in the decompilation projects. It does not read or write ROM files. Therefore, it is highly recommended to use Git for version control when working with Porymap.

flathub:org.kde.tellico.name: Tellico
flathub:org.kde.tellico.description:
Tellico is an application for organizing your collections. It provides default templates for
 books, bibliographies, videos, music, video games, coins, stamps, trading cards, comic books, and
 wines. It allows you to enter your collection in a catalogue database, saving many different properties
 like title, author, etc.
 Features:
 Supports default collections of books, bibliographic entries, videos, music, video games,
 comic books, coins, stamps, trading cards, wines, board games, and file catalogs
 Supports user-defined custom collections
 Supports any number of user-defined fields, of several different types: text, paragraph,
 list, checkbox, number, URL, date, images, and combinations
 Handles entries with multiple authors, genres, keywords, etc
 Automatically formats titles and names
 Supports collection searching and view filtering
 Sorts and groups collection by various properties
 Allows customizable entry templates through XSLT
 Imports MODS, Bibtex, RIS, CSV, PDF metadata, and many other formats
 Exports to Bibtex, ONIX, CSV, HTML, and other formats
 Imports information directly from Amazon.com, IMDb, z39.50 servers, PubMed, SRU servers,
 CrossRef.org, various other websites, and from external scripts
 Imports CDDB data for cataloging audio CDs
 Scans and imports audio file collections, such as mp3 or ogg

Linux Show Player, LiSP for short, is a free cue player, mainly intended for sound-playback in stage productions,

firefox-addons:2822818.name: Auto-On Video Controls
firefox-addons:2822818.summary: Automatically turns on the browser's native video controls on HTML5 videos, so you never right-click "Show Controls" again. You choose the sites. Light on resources, private and open source.
firefox-addons:2822818.description:
Stop right-clicking "Show Controls" on every video.
Some pages play a video but hide the playback controls: no pause button, no seek bar, no volume, no fullscreen. This extension automatically turns on the browser's own native controls on HTML5 video elements, including videos that a page adds while you scroll.
HOW IT WORKS
• Open a page with a video and the controls are there. Nothing to click, nothing to set up.
• It uses the browser's built-in controls. It does not replace the site's player or add a playback engine of its own.
• Controls that a site provides itself are never touched.
YOU CHOOSE WHERE IT RUNS
• On all sites (default), except the sites on your list. Or only on the sites on your list.
• Each mode keeps its own list, and a base domain such as example.com also covers its subdomains.
• Changes apply right away to pages that are already open, with no reload.
LIGHT ON RESOURCES
• On a site where it is off, the extension does no work on the page.
• Where it is on, it only looks at newly added content, in small batches, and it keeps no background process running.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No analytics and no tracking. The extension itself makes no network requests.
• Your site lists, autoplay choice, language and theme are stored locally in your browser.
• Open source under the GPLv3, so you can read exactly what it does.
ALSO INCLUDED
• Optional "Block autoplay", off by default: videos start paused and play when you press play.
• Light, dark or system theme.
• Interface in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
• Small fixes for 9GAG and Instagram, where overlays can cover the controls.
GOOD TO KNOW
• Some sites use custom players that hide or replace the native controls. The extension cannot help there.
• It is off by design on YouTube, Netflix, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Hulu, Twitch, Rumble, Facebook and TikTok.
• Browsers do not allow extensions on their own internal pages or on extension stores.
Found a site where it does not work? Open an issue with the page address and your browser version: https://github.com/FelipheMP/auto-on-video-controls/issues 
If it makes your browsing easier, you can support development at https://github.com/sponsors/FelipheMP or https://ko-fi.com/coreboolean 
Based on "Show Video Controls by Default" by marcintracz.official. Adapted and maintained by FelipheMP.
Works on Firefox for desktop and for Android.

firefox-addons:947990.name: Tab Unloader for Tree Style Tab
firefox-addons:947990.summary: Tab unload options for Tree Style Tab.
firefox-addons:947990.description:
⚠ This addon extends and works only with Tree Style Tab .
This extension allows you to click on a tab in Tree Style Tab's sidebar to unload it. You can set conditions for which clicks will be used. It is also possible to block Tree Style Tab's default action for a click.
Conditions for clicks:
 Hold certain modifier keys while making the click. (Such as: ctrl, shift, alt, meta/command.)
 Tab is/isn't double clicked.
 Tab is/isn't long-pressed.
 Tab is/isn't long pressed without tab being dragged. (special event from Tree Style Tab's API.)
If the tab that should be unloaded is the current tab then you can control what tab should be selected instead with the following options:
 Select the last focused tab instead of the closest.
 Ignore hidden tabs.
Context menu items that can be added to the context menu in Tree Style Tab's Sidebar:
 Unload tab.
 Unload tree.
 Unload tree descendants.
 Unload other tabs.
 The context menu items can be added after a slight delay to ensure that they are the last items in the menu. If there are more than one item they will be grouped under a parent item.
This extension can also:
 allow keyboard shortcuts to unload tab/tree (requires Firefox 60 or later).
 Dim unloaded tabs in the Tree Style Tab Sidebar.
 Hide all unloaded tabs so that they aren't visible in the toolbar and can't be selected with keyboard shortcuts. Hidden tabs are also not selected when you close the current tab. Useful to prevent accidental loading of unloaded tabs.
 Show hidden tabs in the Tree Style Tab Sidebar. Useful when combined with the option to hide unloaded tabs.
 Fix some bugs with Firefox unload method. For example tabs that aren't restore correctly after being unloaded by an extension or tabs that are marked by Firefox as loaded when they are unloaded. These fixes work for other tabs that are unloaded by other extensions as well. (This is a workaround for a Firefox bug that is fixed as of Firefox 62.)
 Unload tabs via the Auto Tab Discard extension. (Can be useful to change the icon of unloaded tabs)
When using the default configuration:
 Hold the alt key and click tabs to unload them.
 Middle click on loaded tabs to unload them. (Not possible in Tree Style Tab v2.4.18 or earlier.) (Also you can double middle click or middle click while holding a modifier key to close tabs that can't be unloaded, such as addon option pages.)
 Hold a modifier key and right click tabs to unload them.
 Unloaded tabs are dimmed.
 Unload tab context menu item in Tree Style Tab Sidebar context menu.
Note that all functionality is fully customizable in the options page.

firefox-addons:3105452.summary: Personalize Discord with eight material themes, anime backgrounds, custom pictures, readable glass and a focus shortcut.
firefox-addons:3105452.description:
Theme Studio changes the appearance of Discord’s website with selectable colour themes, background scenes and adjustable glass panels.
Use the toolbar menu to choose a look or restore the website’s normal appearance. The background editor lets you choose a bundled scene or use your own picture, adjust scene visibility, and choose light or dark panels. You can assign different scenes to friends, direct messages and servers.
Focus mode hides the background while keeping the theme colours. Theme changes update open tabs, and a configurable keyboard shortcut toggles focus mode.
Preferences and prepared pictures stay in local extension storage. There are no analytics, advertising trackers, developer servers or separate accounts. The extension does not post, send messages or access account credentials.
For Discord’s website in Firefox. This independent extension is not affiliated with or endorsed by Discord or Firefox. Artwork credits are included in the background editor.
Made by ArclineLabs.
Contact, feedback and bug reports: arclinelabs@gmail.com 
Support: https://yadavsourabhgh.github.io/discord-theme/ 
Privacy: https://yadavsourabhgh.github.io/discord-theme/privacy/

apple-macos:6774184340.name: Zus Player
apple-macos:6774184340.description:
Zus Player is a powerful media player that delivers a smooth, high-quality viewing experience on iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV. It supports M3U, M3U8, and Xtream Codes playlists, letting you play your personally owned media from local storage or remote sources.
Key Features:
- Supports M3U, M3U8 & Xtream Codes API
- High-quality playback with advanced VLC-based engine
- Support multi screen
- Download VOD for offline viewing
- Record channels in the background
- Switch subtitles & audio tracks
- Closed captions for live channels
- Customise categories, channels & favourites
- Available in 8 languages
- Native Apple TV & Siri Remote support
- Open Subtitles support
- AirPlay
- Chromecast
Important Notice:
Zus Player is a standalone media player. It does not provide, host, or promote any content. Users must supply their own legally acquired media. By using this app, you agree to our Terms of Use: https://zusplayer.com/terms/
